purpose: Use NotebookLM as a private, candidate-only tree and landmark-case proposer, then verify every public case fruit before attaching to backend doctrine branches.

phases.description: Try existing domain packs and doctrine_node_id routes before asking NotebookLM.
Ask NotebookLM for metadata-only field/branch tree, routing keywords, statutory anchors, and candidate case names.
Optionally ask DeepSeek/API for additional candidate case names; treat every result as hallucination-risk until public-source verified.
Verify candidate cases through LegalRef/HKLII/Judiciary, extract paragraphs, and require exact quote match before any proposition card.
Attach quote-verified proposition cards to existing or newly proposed doctrine_node_id as machine_candidate only.
Human review may promote source_verified proposition cards to answer_safe. The workflow must never do this automatically.

hard_gates: No private book excerpt may be committed.
No proposition without exact public-source quote match.
No tree link without known doctrine_node_id or candidate branch record.
No answer_safe without explicit review approval.
